svg.text: REFERENCE ONLY — DO NOT UPLOAD THIS FILE. Upload bracket_flat_plate.dxf.
Fridge-side display mount — flat pattern, A36/1008 mild steel 0.119" (3.02 mm)
portrait · formed arm 180 + neck 257 + body 310 mm · arm width 190 mm · bend deduction 4.97 mm · flat 310.0 x 742.0 mm
dashed LINE in the DXF — the app reads
ARM — rests on the fridge top
O32.0 x 8.00 mm body / O32.0 x 8.00 mm arm
4 x 18 strap slots, 5 pairs up the
neck and arm — captures the power lead
O8.5 strut bolt holes, 2 rows at 187 centres — the third design's
struts bolt here. Absent on the archived hook
Pi fan / GPIO opening in the display's rear box,
R88 from the VESA centre — drawn in all four
rotations. A vent window covers it in each.
Display rear box 134 x 260 mm as mounted (portrait),
standing 25 mm proud of the panel.
schematic, 0.55x. Vertical load bears at the top corner; magnets carry none.
same pad, 72 mm x2 down the neck
rear box 260 x 134 x 25 mm — VESA lands here
ONE pad stock, 8.00 mm (0.315 in), everywhere the bracket meets the fridge — arm, neck and bottom.
Matched to the 8.00 mm magnet so the magnets bear, not the pad.
on the NECK it is two strips 72 mm wide with a 45 mm channel between them for the straps
4 x O32 x 8 mm top-lip magnets, same SKU as the body — zero VERTICAL load, but they do resist peel
8 x O32 x 8 mm BARE nickel pot magnets, M6 male stud — tape the fridge, not the magnet
bottom bearing pad 8.00 mm, +0.00 mm proud of the magnets — sponge squashes flush
display 43 mm overall = 18 mm panel + 25 mm rear box, 3.94 kg; CG offset d = 50.5 mm, volume-weighted
A36/1008 mild steel plate 3.02 mm, inside bend R 1.60 mm
Vertical load 18.78 lb (display 8.69 + bracket 10.09) bears at the top corner. Magnets carry ZERO vertical load.
Touch torsion: 5 lb at 162 mm = 32.0 in-lb over 246 mm spacing -> 3.30 lb/side, 1.65 lb/magnet (SF 15.9x on 26.25 lb derated pull).
Peel 1.92 lb over H = 278 mm — negligible, as expected. Arm pad budget 3.92 mm = corner gap at the R_f = 15 mm envelope; the 8.00 mm (1/4 in) pad gives 2.04x and covers a measured R_f up to 24 mm.
Display is not a slab: 18 mm panel + 25 mm raised rear box = 43 mm overall, VESA on the box. Vent windows sit at R88 so one lands over the Pi fan opening in every 90 deg rotation.
Neck bending 1192 psi (SF 30x); body weak axis 1594 psi (SF 23x) vs 36000 psi yield. No ribs required.
